chunks: Surely its collection and recitation are Our responsibility.
ai.seo_question: What is Allah's responsibility regarding the Quran according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qiyamah is often cited to affirm the divine guarantee of the Quran's textual integrity and its oral transmission, distinguishing the revealed text from later additions. The term 'jam' (collection) underscores Allah's role in gathering the scattered revelations, while 'qur'an' (recitation) highlights the rhythmic, authoritative delivery entrusted to the Prophet, reinforcing the concept of divine preservation (Ismah) of the scripture.
